beats.narration: Your phone may be keeping a map of the places you go. Including this one.
beats.visual: Dark bedroom at night, phone on a nightstand. Screen snaps on: an unnamed city map at night; a red trail draws itself pin by pin; the last pin pulses. On-screen label: 'Illustration'.

beats.narration: On iPhone, Apple says it keeps track of where you've been, how often, when, and your routes.
beats.visual: Macro shot along the phone; the trail redraws as a list of visited places with times (generic place names, no real person's data). On-screen label: 'Illustration'.

beats.narration: On Android, Google Maps Timeline, once it's on, saves your visits and routes to your phone, even when Google apps aren't open.
beats.visual: Second phone on the bed in moonlight; generic Timeline-style day view (no Google branding). On-screen label: 'Illustration'.

beats.narration: Apple says it can't read yours. Google keeps it on your phone. Either way, it's a diary of your days.
beats.visual: Slow push into the glowing map; trails like handwriting across the city.

beats.narration: Here's where to find it. Look first. Then keep it, or turn it off.
beats.visual: Clean on-screen steps over the dimmed bedroom, each line appearing in turn.
onScreenText: iPhone: Settings > Privacy & Security > Location Services
Android: Google Maps > profile picture > Your Timeline

beats.narration: Google can auto-delete it after three, eighteen or thirty-six months. At the longest, that's three years of places. It's on your phone right now. Go check.
beats.visual: The map zooms out: one night's trail becomes a dense glowing web over the whole city (on-screen label 'Illustration'); heartbeat accelerates then stops; silence; '36 months' appears; the screen switches off and its black glass reflects the bedroom; one low hit; cut to black.

caption:
Your phone may keep a map of where you go. Here is where to find it.
LU-TECH-003

iPhone: Settings > Privacy & Security > Location Services > System Services > Significant Locations & Routes.
Android: Google Maps > profile picture > Your Timeline.

Sources:
- Apple, "Location Services & Privacy", apple.com/legal/privacy/data/en/location-services
- Apple Personal Safety User Guide, "Manage Location Services settings", support.apple.com
- Google Maps Help, "Manage your Google Maps Timeline" (Android and iPhone), support.google.com/maps/answer/6258979
Limits: these settings apply when turned on; menu names can differ by version and language. Apple and Google describe their own encryption; this video does not test it. Map visuals are illustrations; map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.
